'''Mistress Calder''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident of [[Emond's Field]].

== Activities ==
Her house is used after the [[Trolloc]] raid in Emond's Field for those hurt and being tended by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]].
